# TDK source CAD

Original manufacturer technical assets, preserved byte-for-byte. Sources and hashes are recorded in `sources/tdk-mechanical-cad.json`. TDK retains rights in these files; the repository MIT license does not relicense manufacturer assets.

`B66285G_ungapped.stp` is the clamp-recess core shape linked from B66285G0000X187. The derived assembly models the 0.05 mm factory center gap of the ordered B66285G0050X187; this is a CAD operation, not an instruction to machine the purchased part.

`B66286A2000X000.stp` is the clip in its free shape. It must open elastically to seat on the core pair. The displayed installed pose is a geometric surrogate. It does not establish spring stress, retention force or allowable deformation.
